problem: A prospective client cannot tell whether an automation review will diagnose a real operational bottleneck or become a generic technology pitch.
single_message: Run Lighter follows one real workflow through people and systems, finds where it gets stuck and recommends one practical starting point while keeping judgement human.
supporting_points: Trace a recent piece of work from trigger to completion

angle: A useful review follows the work until the expensive snag is visible instead of starting with software or AI tools.

search_question: What happens during an on-site automation review?
direct_answer: An on-site automation review follows one real workflow through your business, identifies repeated work and handover friction, separates rules from judgement and recommends one practical place to start.
promotion_hypothesis: A concrete explanation of the review process should reduce uncertainty for provider-aware Sydney owners without promising a result that has not been measured.
risk_notes: Do not promise quantified time, revenue or cost savings
